ORIGIN.quote: But names such as “Anthropic” and “Claude” are self-descriptions. IP prefixes are coarse, and labels can be reused or copied.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that Anthropic/Claude labels appear in the data and that the report treats them as untrustworthy self-descriptions from which no model or operator identity can be inferred, so the origin question is raised only to be closed off. It sits below the 0.4 anchor because the report never actually frames Anthropic as a candidate source or deployment before dismissing it — it only notes the names in passing within an attribution-limits paragraph — but it is above 0.2 because that paragraph explicitly ties the names to the question of who or what produced the swarm.
